name: Manus O'Donnell
note: Imprisoned and deposed by his son Calvagh in 1555; Died during imprisonment in Lifford.

name: Hugh McManus O'Donnell
note: Seized power in 1561 with Calvagh's imprisonment. Became senile in his later years and abdicated.

name: Hugh Roe O'Donnell II
note: Senior confederate commander in the Nine Years' War. Died in Simancas whilst seeking Spanish reinforcements.

name: Niall Garbh O'Donnell
note: disputed; Fought for the Crown during the Nine Years' War. Traditionally inaugurated but challenged by Rory. Arrested for instigating O'Doherty's rebellion and sent to the Tower of London for life in 1609.

name: Rory O'Donnell
note: disputed; Elevated as Earl of Tyrconnell by King James on 4 September 1603. Took part in the Flight of the Earls. Died in Rome of fever.; list ends with Rory (d. 1608)
